issue_summary.problem: 2 PATH-type FAIL in smoke query tests caused by REPO_ROOT derivation using fixed '..' depth count instead of searching for frozen engine anchor
issue_summary.root_cause: Scripts at dshe/ level (6 parents to repo root) and dshe/followup/ level (7 parents) used hardcoded '..' counts. When engine MD5 check failed (wrong path resolved to non-frozen engine at D:\DSH_WORK\scripts\), tests reported PATH FAIL instead of correct PASS
affected_tests: TC-PATH-01: REPO_ROOT resolution from dshe/ subdirectory
TC-PATH-02: REPO_ROOT resolution from dshe/post_perf_validate/ subdirectory
issue_summary.fix_strategy: Replace fixed '..' depth counting with iterative parent-search that locates the frozen engine anchor at scripts/node_binding_engine.py and validates MD5
issue_summary.impact: Eliminates false-positive PATH FAILs across all script depth levels (dshe/, followup/, post_perf_validate/)

path_resolution_algorithm.name: anchor_search_repo_root
path_resolution_algorithm.description: Walk up parent directories from script location, checking each for scripts/node_binding_engine.py with frozen MD5
